title: CKD Risk Prediction (Real vs Synthetic Augmentation)
summary: A chronic kidney disease risk prediction workflow comparing models trained on real data alone versus real data augmented with synthetic samples, including a Streamlit clinical dashboard with counterfactual explanations. The requirements declare sdv and copulas as dependencies for the synthetic data augmentation step, but no confirmed call site to SDV appears in the harvested code.
evidence: requirements.txt: 'sdv>=1.10; python_version < "3.12"' and 'copulas>=0.10; python_version < "3.12"'; no pattern hits in code
needs: Dependency declared but no code call site was found; unclear whether sdv/copulas actually generate the synthetic datasets described in the README's augmentation workflow.
